### Up to Jerusalem
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/jerusalem
Passage: Matthew 20:18
Points:
- As Jesus approaches Jerusalem, He gives His disciples a third explicit prediction of His coming death and resurrection.
- Discipleship entails following Christ on a path that involves hardship, suffering, and the hostility of the world.
- His prophecy of being handed over to the Gentiles underscores the intense shame and rejection He would endure as the sin-bearer.
- The promise of resurrection provided comfort and hope, pointing beyond present affliction to ultimate eternal glory.
